footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $793K income tax benefit, $514K from other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 39.2% to $884K in 2025. The operating loss widened to $114M from $90.9M.
The net loss widened to $103M, or −$1.40 per share, from $79.3M. Operating cash flow was −$82.5M and free cash flow −$95.2M, versus −$72.7M.
sources: Perspective Therapeutics, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company and have a limited operating history upon which to base an investment decision
We will require substantial additional capital to fund our operations
We have incurred losses in nearly every year since our inception, and we anticipate that we will not achieve profits for the foreseeable future
Our product candidates are in early stages of development and must go through clinical trials, which are very expensive, time consuming…
We rely on single vendors to provide supplies and services used in the development and production of our alpha-particle therapies
If we encounter difficulties enrolling patients in our clinical trials, our clinical development activities could be delayed…
